steps.title: Open the Video Center section
steps.description: Navigate to Web Cloud > Video Center in your OVHcloud Control Panel. This page shows your subscription overview with video and minute counters.

steps.title: Access the Video Center interface
steps.description: Click Access the Video Center to open the video management interface in a new browser tab.

steps.title: Video Center dashboard
steps.description: The Video Center interface shows the import area at the top and your video library below. Accepted formats: MP4, MOV, AVI — up to 500 MB per file.

steps.title: Upload a video
steps.description: Click Browse files to pick a video from your computer, or drag and drop a file directly into the dotted area. The upload starts automatically once a file is selected.

steps.title: Embed a video
steps.description: Click Integrate next to any video in My videos to open the embed code window.

steps.title: Copy the iframe code
steps.description: The Embed video window shows the iframe embed code. Click the copy icon to copy it to your clipboard, then paste it into the HTML source code of your web page.
